Edit image 1. It is a photo of the client's own room, and the result must still be that same room, exactly: the same camera position, angle, lens and framing; the same walls, ceiling, floor, light fixture and outlets; the same windows, with the same frames, in the same places. Do not add, remove, move or enlarge any wall, window, door or opening, do not extend, rotate or crop the room, and do not change its light. Wherever no new furniture goes, the result is image 1 unchanged.

Images 2 to 10 are the products to add, one photo each:
image 2: three-seat leather sofa, 193 cm wide, 87 cm deep, 83 cm high
image 3: rattan tub armchair, size unknown
image 4: large southwestern area rug, 335 cm wide, 239 cm deep
image 5: woven patterned cushion cover, 51 cm wide, 51 cm deep, 1 cm high, 3 units
image 6: embossed ceramic plant pot, 17 cm wide, 17 cm deep, 15 cm high, 3 units
image 7: wide open etagere bookcase, 140 cm wide, 21 cm deep, 43 cm high
image 8: round wood coffee table, 110 cm wide, 110 cm deep, 42 cm high
image 9: turned-column floor lamp, 43 cm wide, 43 cm deep, 154 cm high
image 10: geometric jacquard throw blanket, 152 cm wide, 127 cm deep, 1 cm high

Add exactly these products and nothing else: no other furniture, lamps, plants, rugs or decoration than these (books on the shelves of a bookcase are fine). Each one must be the product of its photo, not a similar one: the same design, proportions, colors and materials. A product listed with "2 units" goes twice.

The client asked: "Un living bohemio y con mucho color: un sofá de terciopelo color mostaza, un sillón de ratán, una alfombra estampada grande, almohadones de colores y estampados, varias plantas en macetas de cerámica y una estantería baja con libros. Que se vea vivido y alegre.". Arrange the products as an interior designer would for that, against the walls and on the floor that image 1 shows, each at its real size for this room, lit by this room's light. The result must look like a real photograph of image 1's room.
